annotations.title: Record an operation on an outpost

description: Record one operation done on ONE outpost (seller × marketplace) in the Vendooly action log, so it is remembered and its impact on the KPI can be measured later. Owners/admins only. Call it right AFTER a write that succeeded (Ads, price, listing, stock) or after a manual change the user reports, with the value before → after. Internal Vendooly log: writes nothing on Amazon.

action_type.description: Short code, e.g. bid_change, budget_change, price_change, negative_keyword, listing_fix (max 60 chars).

description.description: What was done, in one sentence (max 500 chars).

kpi.description: KPI the operation is meant to move.

ref.description: Optional: campaign/keyword/SKU/ASIN id or a link.

name: log_action
